instructions: LAB_REPORTED benchmark numbers researched from official lab materials only (D22 stretch, tranche 1, newest-and-most-notable-first). A row publishes to its entry only when status is APPROVED; then run python -m pipeline.apply_lab_numbers --run-date <date>. The applied number carries the pinned benchmark name and version; the benchmark_name_as_stated and quote fields are the evidence trail. unpinned_claims and not_found are records of the research, never applied.
